name: MI-NeRF
definition: A single unified dynamic neural radiance field (NeRF) that models complex non-rigid facial motion for multiple identities using only monocular videos of arbitrary length, reducing total training time by up to 90% compared to standard single-identity NeRFs.
summary: MI-NeRF learns a single unified dynamic NeRF for multiple identities from monocular videos, reducing training time by 90% compared to standard methods.
